aj barner.note: Four TDs in four games on 80%+ snaps; game-script sensitive in Seattle, but the touchdown equity is real at tight end.

alvin kamara.note: Undisputed lead back with Etienne on IR; efficiency is fading at 31, but lead-back volume in half-PPR is bankable.

brashard smith.note: 4.39-speed rookie behind Pacheco and Hunt; chatter about a bigger role -- patient stash only, don't churn him.

brian robinson jr..note: Bijan's handcuff in Atlanta (not San Francisco -- correct the stale tags); zero standalone value, pure insurance.

bryce young.note: Preferred Week 6 streamer against a Dallas defense allowing 304 passing yards a game; 5.4 yards per attempt keeps expectations in check.

darius slayton.note: Nabers (ACL, out for season) opens a starting role, but a hamstring issue plus PHI/DEN/PHI makes this a Weeks 10-15 stash.

darnell mooney.note: Giants WR2 on paper, but 6 catches for 95 yards through four games in a run-first offense -- monitor, don't pay.

devaughn vele.note: Saints depth piece on the add lists; unproven -- deeper-league stash only.

dohnte meyers.note: 7-82 as Burrow's de facto WR1 with Chase (concussion) and Higgins (groin) out, but a former CFL player with no NFL track record -- 5% flier max.

emanuel wilson.note: Seattle's lead back (25.5 half-PPR in Week 4) until Charbonnet's knee allows a return -- possibly as soon as Week 6.

harold fannin jr..note: Touchdown-dependent in Cleveland's offense -- excluded by rulebook.

hassan haskins.note: Best bet for goal-line work in the post-Hampton committee, but a plodder who won't see passing downs -- touchdown-or-bust.

isaiah bond.note: 14 targets over two games is real, but Cleveland is a garbage offense -- excluded by rulebook.

isaiah davis.note: Top backup to Breece Hall with Braelon Allen (knee) out two-plus months -- handcuff only.

jake tonges.note: Kittle's fill-in (7-41-1 in Week 5); startable while Kittle (hamstring) misses at least another week.

jakobi meyers.note: Steady veteran separator now in Jacksonville; RotoBaller top-10 PPR add -- confirm target share before paying full price.

jaxson dart.note: Rushing gives a floor (10-54-1 and 7-55-0 on the ground the last two weeks), but PHI/DEN/PHI is a gauntlet -- roster now, start Weeks 9-10.

joe flacco.note: Emergency quarterbacking in Cincinnati: 2 TDs and 6 INTs in Cleveland behind a 24.3% pressure rate -- 2QB desperation only.

jordyn tyson.note: RotoBaller 'must stash' tag for the Saints rookie; ceiling play with a growing role -- not startable yet.

kareem hunt.note: 9.8 touches a game with goal-line work in Kansas City and 3 TDs; 3.8 YPC at 30 makes him a TD-dependent bye-week flex.

keaton mitchell.note: Led Chargers backs in Week 5 snaps (26) with home-run speed, but it's a committee in a struggling offense -- one play from paying off, zero floor.

kendrick bourne.note: 10 catches for 142 yards filling in for Pearsall, Jennings and Kittle; every target evaporates as they return.

kenneth gainwell.note: RB3 half-PPR finish as Warren's fill-in; Warren reportedly returns Week 6, so this is flex depth plus a high-value contingent cuff.

keon coleman.note: Career game (6-116-1) with D.J. Moore's AC joint sprain sidelining him; 2.38 yards per route run says the role is growing beyond the rental.

khalil shakir.note: 7-82 alongside Coleman's breakout; steady slot role in Buffalo keeps him flex-relevant in full PPR.

kimani vidal.note: Hampton's foot sends him to IR; Vidal's speed and pass-catching should win passing downs in a committee with Haskins.

kyle monangai.note: Runs hard behind D'Andre Swift (-0.39 rushing yards over expected, dead last); a real threat to the job after the bye.

mason taylor.note: 26% target share and 9 catches in Week 5 as the Jets' locked-in No. 2 pass-catcher behind Garrett Wilson -- TE1 volume at a thin position.

michael carter.note: Clear lead back (57% snaps, 18 carries + 5 catches in Week 5) until Benson returns from IR; Conner is out for the season.

michael penix jr..note: 20-of-26 for 313 yards and 2 TDs in Week 4; playable matchups (BUF, @SF) but no rushing floor.

najee harris.note: The Giants' RB2 behind Skattebo, but 11 months removed from a ruptured Achilles -- prove-it stash, not a bid target.

ryan flournoy.note: WR2 in Dallas' pass-happy attack while Lamb (high-ankle, out Week 6) and Turpin sit; window likely shuts when Lamb returns Week 7.

spencer rattler.note: 7:3 TD-to-INT with 123 rushing yards and a soft October slate (NE/CHI/TB) -- viable streamer.

theo johnson.note: Three TDs in two games with a 20% target share; rapport with Dart is growing -- streamer at a thin position.

tre tucker.note: Big-play speed in Las Vegas with useful last two weeks, but the week-to-week volatility is the profile -- warn.

tre' harris.note: The Chargers' most consistent WR with McConkey (foot) sidelined; 5+ targets in 3 of 4 games -- bench depth with a path.

troy franklin.note: 79% route share with three plus matchups ahead (@NYJ, NYG, DAL); real target volume (19.7% share) for a flex.

tua tagovailoa.note: Four straight multi-TD games, but he's quarterbacking a garbage offense -- excluded by rulebook.

tyjae spears.note: Off IR with a 17-snap ramp-up in Week 5; Tennessee wants him more involved -- monitor.

tyler allgeier.note: TD-dependent committee back in Arizona behind Love and Carter; the goal-line role is real but the carries are thin.

tyreek hill.note: Free agent at 32, over a year removed from a knee injury, posting about a comeback -- deepest-league stash only.

wan'dale robinson.note: Slot-dependent PPR piece in Tennessee with a low ceiling -- rosterable, not a priority add.

will shipley.note: Only healthy back on Philly's roster with Barkley week-to-week and Bigsby on IR; 3.1 career YPC in a struggling offense caps it.

xavier worthy.note: 85% route participation with Rice (hamstring) and Thornton (ankle, possibly done for 2026) sidelined; could become Mahomes' top target coming off the bye.

picks.name: Michael Carter
picks.why: Arizona's clear lead back with Benson on IR and Conner out for the season: 57.4% of snaps, 18 carries for 51 yards and a TD plus 5 catches in Week 5 vs Tennessee. Startable until Benson returns.

picks.name: Mason Taylor
picks.why: Back-to-back breakouts: 25.9% target share in Week 4, then 9 catches for 67 yards on a 26% share vs Dallas. Locked in as the Jets' No. 2 pass-catcher behind Garrett Wilson -- plug-and-play TE1.

picks.name: Xavier Worthy
picks.why: 85% route participation in Week 4 with Rashee Rice (hamstring) hurt and Tyquan Thornton (ankle) possibly done for 2026. Coming off the bye, he could become Mahomes' top option. Check availability -- 61% owned.

picks.name: Kendrick Bourne
picks.why: 10 catches for 142 yards on 11 targets (22.4% share, 3.74 yards per route run) in the Week 5 upset of the Rams. Pearsall (knee), Jennings (ankle/ribs) and Kittle (hamstring) are all out -- a 1-2 week rental.

picks.name: Keon Coleman
picks.why: Career game (6-116-1, WR9) after D.J. Moore's AC joint sprain; 78% of snaps, 2.38 yards per route run, 87.5% catch rate. Moore is out at least a week and the Week 7 bye looms -- rental with a growing every-week role.

picks.name: Emanuel Wilson
picks.why: Seattle's lead back (21-81-1 rushing, 3-39-1 receiving, 25.5 half-PPR in Week 4) with Price (chest) on IR until Week 8. Charbonnet (knee) could return as soon as Week 6, so treat as a 1-3 week rental.

picks.name: Kenneth Gainwell
picks.why: 19-99-2 rushing plus 6-35 receiving (RB3 in half-PPR) filling in for Warren (knee) in Week 4. Warren is reportedly back Week 6, but Gainwell earned a bigger role and gets a soft Week 7 date at Cincinnati.

picks.name: Troy Franklin
picks.why: 79% route share in Week 5 with a 19.7% season target share, 30.6% air-yard share and 21.3% first-read rate. Three plus matchups ahead (@NYJ, NYG, DAL) -- solid flex volume.

picks.name: Kimani Vidal
picks.why: Omarion Hampton (foot) is on IR for 4+ games. Vidal is faster than Haskins with better pass-catching chops and should win passing-down work in the committee. Note the decimated Chargers O-line.

picks.name: Kendre Miller
picks.why: Snaps climbing (31% to 39%) with 11-65-1 in Week 4 and 10-41 in Week 5. Kamara is still the lead, and Taysom Hill's return threatens volume -- a stash flirting with flex value and the top cuff.
